Hanoi To Ha Giang By Private Car provided by Vietlook Travel is a door-to-door transfer service to travel to Ha Giang- the Northeast region of Vietnam in a comfortable car with an experienced driver.

Hanoi To Ha Giang Distance

The distance from Hanoi to Ha Giang city center is about 280km and it takes around 6 hours to transfer/ 1 way by car. Unlike other transport from Hanoi to Ha Giang such as taxis or shared buses, it is not convenient and comfortable. By booking our Hanoi Private Car, you will be the boss and can decide the departure time.

Plus, visitors will enjoy a professional private service that prioritizes their privacy and comfort. Additionally, an experienced local driver, knowledgeable about the terrain and routes, will assist you throughout your trip. Not only that, but a high-quality private car will conveniently pick you up and drop you off door-to-door at the hotel address you specify.

HANOI TO HA GIANG BY PRIVATE CAR

Ha Giang is a province located in the northernmost region of Vietnam. It is known for its stunning natural landscapes, rugged mountains, and diverse ethnic cultures.

Moreover, Ha Giang is renowned for its breathtaking landscapes, including the Dong Van Karst Plateau Geopark, which is a UNESCO Global Geopark. The region features towering limestone peaks, deep valleys, terraced rice fields, and picturesque winding roads.

To meet all your diverse travel requests, Vietlook Travel creates some travel options such as

Hanoi Airport To Ha Giang Transfer

Based on your provided details such as the number of people, flight number, landing time, your hotel name/ address in Ha Giang. Our driver will pick you up at the Noi Bai International Airport arrival gate with your full name on the welcome board.

After greetings, we will start the private car Hanoi to Ha Giang transfer. We are always open for a direct transfer which takes around 6 hours or a sightseeing route with a package of 4 days.

Along the way, our friendly driver will be happy to stop at convenient places for you to drink some Vietnamese coffee, have lunch, and go to the toilets.

Upon arrival at your hotel in Ha Giang City, our experienced driver will make sure you do not forget anything in his car and say goodbye to you. Finally, Vietlook Travel wishes you a great time in Ha Giang.

Hanoi To Ha Giang By Car Package

If you would like to have a high-quality Hanoi private car with an experienced driver for 4 days to explore all the highlight attractions of Ha Giang, the Ha Giang loop, please Hotline (+84) 98.339.3588

With experience in tourism in Vietnam for over 12 years, Vietlook Travel highly recommends a perfect 4-day itinerary as below

  • Day 1: The journey starts from Hanoi Hotel/Hanoi Airport to Ha Giang. Upon arrival, we will stop at boundary No.1 overnight at Tam Son Town, Quan Ba District, Ha Giang City.
  • Day 2: Explore Quan Ba Heaven Gate, Yen Minh, Meo Vac districts, and Ma Pi Leng Pass.
  • Day 3: We will visit Dong Van town and Lung Cu flag tower – the palace of the Hmong King.
  • Day 4: Ha Giang- Tuyen Quang City- Hanoi City hotel with the distance is about 372km, and it takes about 9 hours to transfer.

After all, we will drop you off at your hotel in Hanoi city center or Noi Bai International Airport. Vietlook Travel wishes you a great journey with us.

Travel Thoughts

Ha Giang is a destination that offers a unique blend of natural beauty, cultural diversity, and adventure. It’s a place where you can escape the hustle and bustle of urban life and immerse yourself in the tranquil charm of northern Vietnam.

  • Best time to visit: Ha Giang experiences a temperate climate, with cool winters and warm summers. The best time to visit is from September to November when the weather is pleasant, and the rice terraces are lush green.
  • Local Homestays: Staying with local families in traditional homestays is a great way to immerse yourself in the local culture and experience the warmth and hospitality of the people.
  • Local Cuisine: Besides, Ha Giang offers a chance to savor delicious local dishes, which often include fresh ingredients from the region. Don’t miss the opportunity to try traditional dishes like thang co (a hotpot of various meats) and banh cuon (steamed rice rolls).
  • Trekking and Hiking: The province offers excellent trekking and hiking opportunities. You can explore remote villages, terraced fields, and pristine natural beauty on various trekking routes.
  • Ethnic Diversity: The province is home to a variety of ethnic minority groups, including the Hmong, Dao, Tay, and more. Moreover, each group has its own unique traditions, clothing, and way of life. Therefore, visitors have the opportunity to learn about these cultures through homestays and interactions with local communities.
  • Lung Cu Flag Tower: This tower is located at the northernmost point of Vietnam and is a symbol of the country’s sovereignty. Visitors can climb to the top for panoramic views of the surrounding countryside.
  • Ma Pi Leng Pass: Often referred to as the “King of Passes,” Ma Pi Leng Pass offers some of the most spectacular views in the region. It’s a popular spot for motorbike enthusiasts and adventurers.
